d: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Commercial Operations Manager / Commercial Manager to oversee commercial activities, drive business growth, and maximise operational and financial performance. The successful candidate will develop and implement commercial strategies, manage key client relationships, oversee business contracts, identify new market opportunities, and ensure effective coordination across sales, finance, procurement, and operations teams. This role requires strong commercial awareness, strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business leadership capabilities.
Develop and implement commercial strategies to achieve business growth, revenue targets, and profitability objectives.
Oversee daily commercial operations and ensure alignment with organisational goals.
Identify new business opportunities, potential markets, strategic partnerships, and revenue streams.
Manage commercial agreements, contracts, pricing structures, and business negotiations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, suppliers, business partners, and stakeholders.
Monitor sales performance, revenue growth, profit margins, and commercial KPIs.
Develop pricing strategies, cost optimisation plans, and commercial performance improvement initiatives.
Coordinate with sales, marketing, finance, procurement, and operations teams to ensure business efficiency.
Review commercial proposals, tender submissions, quotations, and contractual terms.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify business opportunities.
Oversee contract administration, commercial documentation, and contractual obligations.
Assess commercial risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
Prepare commercial reports, business forecasts, and performance updates for senior management.
Lead, motivate, and develop commercial and business operations teams.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and commercial profitability.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related discipline.
MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience in commercial management, business operations, sales management, or business development.
Previous experience in a senior commercial or operational management position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of commercial strategy, contract management, pricing, revenue generation, and financial performance analysis.
Proven experience in business development, client relationship management, and commercial negotiations.
Good understanding of budgeting, cost control, profitability analysis, and business planning.
Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple commercial projects.
Strong leadership, strategic planning, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant business management or ERP systems.
Ability to work in a dynamic business environment and achieve commercial objectives.
Excellent command of written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
